title: LOD & LOI — Level of Development and Level of Information

scope.purpose: Define paired geometric and non-graphical information expectations and permitted reliance across model progression.

requirements.statement: Visual completeness shall not imply coordination, fabrication readiness, or engineering approval.
Level of Information requirements shall be paired with Level of Development definitions for every modeled element category.
LOD 400 fabrication elements shall be validated against vendor shop drawings prior to construction issuance.

showset_permitted_use.LOD100: Narrative alignment and early spatial exploration; not for fabrication or clearance sign-off.
showset_permitted_use.LOD200: Thematic coordination and initial interfaces; not for final clearances or pricing commitments.
showset_permitted_use.LOD300: Clash detection, coordinated drawings basis, and design intent documentation; not fabrication-ready.
showset_permitted_use.LOD350: Detailed clash resolution and interface/penetration coordination; not final shop model.
showset_permitted_use.LOD400: Fabrication planning and shop/CNC derivation subject to QA/QC.
showset_permitted_use.LOD500: Field-verified operations reference and retrofit planning.
